name: Encantadia: Turn of the Gems
imageAlt: Encantadia: Turn of the Gems Java console battle screen showing elemental skills, damage rolls, and cooldowns
summary: A modular Java-based game integrating custom ASCII art and native file I/O structures.
description: Encantadia: Turn of the Gems is an object-oriented Java console battle game featuring custom ASCII character art, native file I/O state handling, elemental damage ranges, and three distinct combat modes.
techStackContext: Applied foundational OOP concepts to build a modular Java game architecture, utilizing native file I/O for state handling and custom ASCII asset rendering.
